description.value: Word travels fast between settlements, and yours travels faster than most. The first time each day you Demoralize a creature that has heard of your deeds (GM's call), you can do so as a single action instead of the normal one, and the creature doesn't get to see it coming.

cinderfall.incomplete: Compressing Demoralize to a single action (from its normal single-action cost, implying a hidden-attack style surprise effect: 'the creature doesn't get to see it coming') for a specific narrative trigger ('has heard of your deeds (GM's call)') has no rule-element hook for either the action-economy change or the GM-adjudicated trigger.
